text:
marcus: Quick sync — AWS Marketplace onboarding for 'Redwood Compute' image. Need final SKU, legal signoff, and a staging AMI upload. Can infra enable test images in staging by EOD?

lina: @marcus I can start the AMI ingest. Which AMI ID and region? Also need the product manifest (JSON) — do we have a draft?

marcus: Thanks. Region: us-west-2. AMI id will be provided by eng-images team in ~1hr. SKU draft attached in google drive: https://drive.redwood/rdw-marketplace/sku-draft

sam: Heads up — billing mapping requires sku format like RDW-COMP-<tier>-<region>. Can we lock tiers now? free/pro/enterprise?

jess: Recommend free/pro/enterprise. Free = limited tokens, Pro = standard, Enterprise = dedicated. I'll add to product packaging doc.

tara-legal: Quick Q: any outbound telemetry or call-home in the image? We need to confirm data flow for the EULA.

marcus: No telemetry. Agent uses customer-hosted endpoint. We'll add explicit line in docs. @tara-legal can you draft the EULA blurb?

tara-legal: On it. Draft ETA tomorrow morning. Also need to confirm indemnity clause for marketplace listings — will post snippet in #legal later.

lina: infra: starting AMI import job now. Command for audit log: ```aws ec2 import-image --description "rdw-marketplace-staging" --disk-containers file://containers.json``` I'll paste import job id when ready.

partners-bot: AMI import job created: import-ami-0a1b2c3d (status: pending). Link: https://console.aws/imports/import-ami-0a1b2c3d

sam: I'll update billing SKU mapping once we have final SKU. Also let's add trial entitlement mapping: 14-day trial for Pro.

jess: Packaging checklist (quick):
- finalize SKU string
- upload AMI to us-west-2 staging
- legal EULA snippet
- publish manifest + icons
I'll take ownership of icons + manifest.

marcus: Thanks. Goal: internal review tomorrow 10am PT. If AMI and legal are ready, we can submit to AWS sandbox.

lina: AMI import id now: import-ami-0a1b2c3d -> completed. AMI available: ami-0f1e2d3c

tara-legal: EULA blurb posted in #legal. Short snippet: "No telemetry; usage data collected only with customer consent; see privacy policy." Please confirm.

marcus: Confirmed. Thanks all. I'll create the marketplace submission checklist and ping for signoffs. :thumbsup:

jess: ping me when checklist is up, I'll attach icons and manifest.

sam: I'll run SKU -> billing mapping once you drop final SKU.

lina: uploading staging test AMI to sandbox account now.
